messages:
Priya Mehta: Heads-up — Jess's birthday this Friday! Thinking cake in the kitchen at 12:30. Who's in? :tada:
Alex Chen: I'll bring a cake! chocolate or vanilla?
Marta Kowalska: Vegan option please if possible — thanks :)
Samir Patel: remote that week, can chip in with a gift card.
Birthday Bot: 🎂 Birthday reminder: Jess López — Friday. Wishing a happy birthday in advance!
Jess López: you absolute sweethearts, no pressure — but if you insist, chocolate ganache is my weakness :heart:
Alex Chen: Chocolate ganache it is. I'll pick up from `Sweet Tooth Bakery` at 11:45.
Marta Kowalska: Can you grab a vegan option too? `The Green Oven` has a great carrot-apple loaf.
Priya Mehta: Awesome — I'll create a calendar invite and add a virtual meet link for remote folks.
Priya Mehta: Quick poll: cake only / snacks & drinks / lunch meetup — vote with a reaction :ballot_box_with_check:
Luna Park: happy birthday Jess! I'll pop into the virtual call from Singapore :wave:
Samir Patel: If anyone wants to contribute to a card/gift, DM me and I'll collect PayPal/Venmo.
Jess López: thanks everyone <3 — see you Friday (or on the call)!
Alex Chen: Adding a sticky note on the fridge: "Do not eat until 12:15" :laughing:
Priya Mehta: Invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 (placeholder). Last call for dietary reqs.
